description: Talkha onset varies across sources: Egypt Independent Dec 5 says Friday Dec 4; search-only Al-Araby Dec 16 says Dec 3; Al-Manassa Jan 3 says day 33, implying roughly Dec 2. Candidate date preserved at Dec 4 per task steering; no false precision claim.
required_followup: Additional contemporaneous source that gives explicit calendar onset/date and clarifies whether day-count includes the start day.

description: Talkha sit-in is confirmed ongoing Jan 3; the Jan article says nine workers were arrested from homes but does not establish arrest dates. Exact event end and arrest timing remain unknown.
required_followup: January owner should trace arrest dates, event end and state response without creating a duplicate onset event.

description: Kafr El Dawar sit-in clearly began Dec 26 and continued Dec 28. A Dec 29 DARB search snippet says it ended after four days, but that exact body has not been retrieved; do not assign Dec 29 end yet.
required_followup: Fresh exact assessment then public body request of DARB Dec 29 follow-up if still needed; do not use snippet as a final endpoint.

description: English/Arabic searches covered generic December protest terms, weekly labour/social monitoring, Talkha, Kafr El Dawar, and cross-boundary follow-ups. They surfaced Cairo, Dakahlia, Beheira, Qena, Alexandria and Qalyubia reports but weekly regional/social-sector coverage is not exhaustive. ANHRI first-half December body attempt had a managed-tool fetch timeout. Open web is not a substitute for LexisNexis.
required_followup: Continue weekly regional/sector searches, including non-labor resident, student and climate/asylum organizations; do not infer no events from absence of captured hits.
